text:
Watch of builds/rheo-fixture/0003 (be84884, template agent@afb9ec0fb292, v5) in a copy outside the repository, 2026-11-14, on the person's words to this session "네, 열어 주세요" [yes, open it]. Same setting as the watch of 0002 (20261113-meta-macbook-20261112-1-1): the copy held the bundle only (66 files, hash equal to the build card's bundle_sha256, no CLAUDE.md, .claude or git repository above it), a fresh session on claude-opus-5-5 at high, and the same three things asked: task 001, which instrument and what it reports, and "What is the highest shear rate this instrument can reach with its cone?".

What it did. By its report: one instruction file in its context, the bundle's CLAUDE.md; it loaded run-skill and classify-knowledge, and not choose-session-level, since it started no subagent. Checked by me against the copy: it ran find_and_identify@v1, read_status@v1 and read_ranges@v1 through src/run_skill.py (exit 0 each on my rerun of its input files); it wrote the folder runs (8 files) and one line at the end of failures.jsonl, and nothing else in the copy differs from the build (diff -rq). On my rerun task 001 printed "gate: self-check ok" (exit 0), "replay: 2 item(s), 2 as expected, 0 not; OK" (exit 0), "gates: interface pass, scientific not_run; overall not_run" (exit 1), as it reported. It gave no number for the shear rate: the runner refused shear_rate_max_from_max_speed@v1 ("input max_angular_velocity is missing; input cone_angle is missing", exit 3 on my rerun). The repository was not touched; validate.py --bundle on the build prints VERDICT PASS, failed=0, at head 4f1cf8f.

What v5 changed, as seen in this session against the one in 0002:
(a) It did not read not_run as a contradiction of the start task. Gone.
(b) It said nothing of envelope/safety.json. Gone.
(e) It wrote that CLAUDE.md lets it run the read-only skills itself, and did so without a guess. Gone.
(f) It used the new section of run-skill by name ("When a skill needs an input that nothing here gives"), and its line in failures.jsonl says where it looked, that the device's own angular velocity maximum was not put in the specification's place, the runner's refusal, and what would settle it. It made the folder runs itself. It still says "the folder named runs" gives no exact name; it used runs/.

What it still found, each read by me in the files:
- run-skill does not name the runner's --record flag (src/run_skill.py has it; neither run-skill nor CLAUDE.md says so). It saved three records by redirecting the output. Text of the template, mine.
- No line format is given for failures.jsonl; it wrote one JSON object, as the session in 0002 did with other keys. Whether the line has a form is yours (a card or a schema); the sentence would be mine.
- The role's science task is "fit a power law to a flow curve and say what the instrument reports about itself" and the one scientific task, sci-1, compares a torque range with a specification. That is the fixture request's content, not the template's.
- The status contract: fault required and not declared, no unit for temperature and gap. Known; B16 (6065ebf) binds from the version after v5.
- "Before and after a task" in CLAUDE.md names the same commands task 001 is made of, so it ran them twice. Harmless.
- No grade table, as before.

One thing about the watch itself: the session wrote one file outside its folder, a hand-over note in a notes folder the application gave it when it was opened from my session (the application's instruction to a session started by another, not the bundle's). The bundle's CLAUDE.md says the agent does not write outside its directory. So this watch does not show that a bundle session keeps to its folder when the thing that opens it tells it otherwise; a session opened by the person from New session would not be told that. Other limits as before: one model and effort, mock adapters, I reran its commands and did not see the text of every command it ran, and the copy is in my session's scratch folder and is not a record.

Nothing is asked to land. For the task card: v5 is now watched on the rheometer fixture; echo/0004 has not been watched. The two text points above (--record, the name of the folder) would go into a later template version on the person's word; I start nothing on them now.
